title: The memo about the fence
body: Custodial says the bolt cutters are out. You hold them. They are heavy and patient and older than the building. The memo about the annex fence — the one that says the fence is not there — is pinned above the shelf where they were not.

outcome.text: THE ANNEX SUB-BASEMENT ACCESS FENCE HAS BEEN REMOVED. NO FENCE EXISTS AT THIS LOCATION. The staples are fresh. The fence is not there. The cutters are in your hand.
You put them back. The shelf takes them like a drawer taking a key. You will need them later. Something will need them.
